You are the Main Programmer continuing the EXISTING Agent Control v2 lane in this exact reconciled worktree. This is implementation work, not an audit.

Current worktree branch: controller-agentcontrol-cycle4
Current reconciled HEAD before your edits: b9685d2f2e32af99596dc90d46278a129106d8e2
Canonical PR lane: feature/agent-control-plane-v2-20260928 / PR #59
Do NOT create another broad branch. Do NOT push, merge, force-update, or touch unrelated product lanes. Make edits only in this worktree and leave them for the controller to inspect.

P1 release blockers already independently verified:
1) server.mjs assertWorkerPlacement() rejects a target different from the controller hostname; engineering autopilot is restricted to heaven2 and all automatic dispatch uses machine:auto, so heavy workers cannot actually execute on heaven.
2) deployOne() still launches local Codex as exec --json --approve-for-me ... . Live runtime evidence says this violates the validated safe local-worker invocation contract. Do NOT guess replacement flags.

Required objective:
Implement the smallest reliable worker-provider seam that preserves heaven2 as control/credential authority and permits heavy/background Agent Control work to execute on heaven using the existing Heaven Local Bridge/local worker architecture. Use the existing architecture instead of inventing a greenfield transport. Fail closed when the remote provider is unavailable, stale, unauthenticated, or cannot prove job identity/result. Do not copy secrets to heaven or place credentials in relay job JSON/logs.

Important local bridge facts:
- canonical protocol: chatgpt-heaven-bridge-v2
- canonical private relay branch: heaven-bridge
- queue: heaven-bridge/queue/<job-id>.json
- results: heaven-bridge/results/<job-id>.json
- status: heaven-bridge/status/<job-id>.json
- worker host: heaven
- v3 bridge health/result envelopes are authoritative; current bridge is healthy again.
- local bridge source/runtime exists separately under the user profile; do not modify that bridge in this worktree.
- current Agent Control should not pretend remote execution exists if required configuration is absent.

Implementation requirements:
- Introduce a clear worker-provider abstraction or bounded equivalent rather than scattering transport logic.
- Local provider must preserve existing safety tests and MUST NOT use --approve-for-me. Before changing invocation flags, inspect the locally available validated invocation/router contract if accessible. If it cannot be established exactly, make the local provider fail closed for unsafe direct launch rather than inventing flags, and document/test the blocker.
- Heaven provider must submit uniquely identified work, observe status/heartbeat/result, and map completed/failed/cancelled/stale truth into Agent Control lifecycle without marking crashed/stopped work successful.
- Preserve one-worktree/branch/lease semantics and exact task identity as far as the existing architecture permits.
- Keep services loopback/private; no firewall weakening or public unauthenticated listener.
- Autopilot on heaven2 should prefer heaven for heavy implementation/test/review/repair when the provider is configured and healthy, while maintaining a deterministic fail-closed behavior otherwise.
- Do not auto-merge/release/publish.
- Add deterministic regression tests for provider selection, unavailable/stale provider behavior, remote failure not becoming success, and the local launch-argument contract.
- Update README/CONTROL_PLANE only to reflect behavior actually implemented.
- Preserve current-main release/version/continuity state from the reconciliation.

Verification:
Run from tools/agent-control:
npm run check
npm test
Also run any new focused test/smoke you add.
If you cannot safely implement the full seam with available evidence, implement only the safe prerequisite abstraction/tests and leave an exact blocker in your final output; do not bluff.

At the end, report:
- files changed
- exact behavior implemented
- exact commands/tests and pass/fail
- unresolved blockers
- git status
Do not commit or push.
